Multi-Module Dotplot for gprofiler2 Enrichment Results

Source: R/aether_enrichment_plots.R
AETHER_plot_gost_dotplot.Rd

Creates a dotplot showing top enriched terms across multiple modules/gene lists from gprofiler2 results. Modules are shown on the X-axis, terms on the Y-axis, with dot size representing odds ratio (default) or gene count, and color representing significance.

Usage

AETHER_plot_gost_dotplot(
  gost_result,
  source,
  top_n = 10,
  modules = NULL,
  color_by = "p_value",
  size_by = "odds_ratio",
  order_by = "p_value",
  title = NULL,
  font_size = 9,
  max_term_length = 50,
  color_low = "#2166ac",
  color_high = "#b2182b",
  dot_range = c(2, 8)
)

Arguments

gost_result

A gost_enrichment object from APOLLO_enrich_gost(), or a data.frame with the required columns (typically the $combined element).

source

Character. Which source to plot (e.g., "GO:BP", "KEGG", "REAC"). Required - only one source per plot for clarity.

top_n

Integer. Number of top terms to show per module (default = 10).

modules

Character vector. Specific modules to include. If NULL (default), includes all modules.

color_by

Character. Variable for color scale: "p_value" (default), "odds_ratio", "precision", or "recall".

size_by

Character. Variable for dot size: "odds_ratio" (default), "intersection_size", "precision", or "recall".

order_by

Character. How to order terms on Y-axis: "p_value" (default), "odds_ratio", "intersection_size", or "term_name".

title

Character. Plot title. If NULL, auto-generated from source.

font_size

Numeric. Base font size (default = 9).

max_term_length

Integer. Maximum characters for term names (default = 50).

color_low

Character. Color for low values (default = "#2166ac" blue).

color_high

Character. Color for high values (default = "#b2182b" red).

dot_range

Numeric vector of length 2. Min and max dot sizes (default = c(2, 8)).

Value

A ggplot object.

Details

The plot shows:

  • X-axis: Modules (gene lists)

  • Y-axis: Enriched terms (top N per module, union across modules)

  • Dot size: Odds ratio (default) - strength of association

  • Dot color: -log10(p-value) - significance

Odds ratio is calculated as: (k/n) / (M/N) simplified, or more precisely using the 2x2 contingency table where OR > 1 indicates enrichment.

Terms are selected as top N per module, then displayed as a union. A term may appear significant in one module but not another - dots only appear where the term was significant in that module.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Plot GO:BP results for all modules
p <- AETHER_plot_gost_dotplot(gost_results, source = "GO:BP")

# KEGG pathways, top 5 per module, color by odds ratio
p <- AETHER_plot_gost_dotplot(gost_results, source = "KEGG", top_n = 5,
                               color_by = "odds_ratio")

# Specific modules only
p <- AETHER_plot_gost_dotplot(gost_results, source = "GO:BP",
                               modules = c("blue", "turquoise", "brown"))

} # }
